fact: As of the July 2024 technical note, ReCoDe had been deployed for testing in 680 communes, the data of the 13 Pro-ARIDES communes were centralised on the DGCT central server, and its local-tax module is rolled out with a census of the taxable base, a database of the recorded items and an electronic ticket coded per taxpayer, though the interconnection of the DGCT and DNTCP servers was delayed.
title: Digitalisation de la collecte des impôts et taxes pour une bonne traçabilité des recettes
